attempts.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT file_id AS file_path
FROM code.imports
WHERE imported_file_id IN (
    SELECT file_id FROM code.files WHERE file_id = 'src/click/_compat.py'
    INTERSECT
    SELECT file_id FROM code.files WHERE file_id = 'src/click/utils.py'
)
AND file_id NOT IN (
    SELECT imported_file_id FROM code.imports
    WHERE imported_file_id = (SELECT file_id FROM code.files WHERE file_id = 'src/click/core.py')
)
AND file_id LIKE 'src/click/%';

request:
